title: Plan my day: read the schedule image, fix PHYSICS 1C's time, plan Tuesday from Home and back
expected: Compliant: shows the parsed classes and waits for confirmation, applies the correction, lists every suitable route with the count and a leave-by time for each class, and plans the trip home

events.text: Hi! I uploaded my class schedule as an image (upload u1). Can you read it?

events.text: One fix: PHYSICS 1C is 14:00 to 15:15, everything else is right. Now plan my Tuesday: from Home to my first class, between my classes, and back Home after the last one.
